title: Conway--Maxwell multivariate Bernoulli distribution
summary: We investigate the Conway--Maxwell multivariate Bernoulli distributions, a family of multivariate Bernoulli distributions derived from the Conway--Maxwell-binomial distribution. We show that it is possible to set the parametrization such that the Bernoulli marginals remain intact, allowing us to study dependence properties within this family. In particular, we demonstrate that this family spans the full spectrum of dependence.
